footer.summary: VUM CRM helps businesses centralize customer data, control the pipeline, and run sales processes on one unified platform.

metadata.homeTitle: VUM CRM | Control the entire sales process
metadata.homeDescription: Centralize customer data and manage pipeline, quotes, contracts, and sales performance on a CRM platform for Vietnamese enterprises.
metadata.featuresTitle: VUM CRM Features | From lead to contract
metadata.featuresDescription: Explore how VUM CRM manages the full customer lifecycle, opportunities, quotes, contracts, automation, and data governance.
metadata.solutionsTitle: VUM CRM Solutions | Sales operations built around your business model
metadata.solutionsDescription: Standardize sales processes across regions, teams, and complex B2B cycles with centrally governed customer data.
metadata.pricingTitle: VUM CRM Services | Consultation based on operational needs
metadata.pricingDescription: Define the VUM CRM implementation scope based on team size, process complexity, and data-governance requirements.
metadata.demoDescription: Talk directly with the VUM team about your sales process, customer data, and an appropriate implementation scope.

hero.title: One system for the entire B2B sales lifecycle
hero.description: Centralize customer data, control the pipeline, and standardize quotes and approvals around your organization.
hero.visualCaption: Illustrative data from the VUM CRM interface

problem.title: Fragmented data makes the sales team react more slowly than the customer
problem.description: VUM CRM connects data, responsibility, and the next action in one operating flow.
problem.beforeDataTitle: Information lives in many files and with many people
problem.beforeDataDescription: The team spends time reconciling versions before it can act.
problem.beforePipelineTitle: The pipeline becomes clear only before review meetings
problem.beforePipelineDescription: Managers struggle to spot opportunities without an owner or next action.
problem.beforeApprovalTitle: Quotes and approvals are detached from deal history
problem.beforeApprovalDescription: Manual handoffs lose context and extend response cycles.
problem.afterTitle: When operations run on VUM CRM
problem.afterDescription: Every customer, opportunity, quote, and contract is connected in a trackable operating flow.

workflow.title: Stay with the customer from the first signal to the contract
workflow.description: Every stage retains its context, owner, and next action.
workflow.leadDescription: Centralize lead sources, handling status, and ownership before conversion.
workflow.accountDescription: Connect the organization, contacts, activities, and lifecycle stage in one record.
workflow.opportunityTitle: Control the pipeline and next action
workflow.opportunityDescription: Track the stage, value, timing, and responsibility for every opportunity.
workflow.quoteDescription: Create quotes from the product catalog while retaining the related opportunity context.
workflow.approvalTitle: Route decisions to the right owner and scope
workflow.approvalDescription: Track review status and approval responsibility in the quote or contract flow.
workflow.contractTitle: Carry the data forward after the deal closes
workflow.contractDescription: Retain value, status, and related history as the opportunity becomes a contract.

roles.title: Each role sees what it needs to make a decision
roles.executiveTitle: See revenue and risk from the same source of data
roles.executivePointPipeline: Track pipeline and revenue trends across the organization
roles.executivePointRisk: Identify regions or stages where work is blocked
roles.executivePointReporting: Reduce dependence on manually consolidated reports
roles.managerTitle: Know which opportunities need support before it is too late
roles.managerPointOwnership: Control ownership across teams and assigned scopes
roles.managerPointStalled: Find opportunities without a next action
roles.managerPointApproval: Track quotes and decisions waiting for action
roles.salesTitle: Keep the full context before every customer interaction
roles.salesPointContext: Review records, contacts, and interaction history in one place
roles.salesPointQuote: Create and track quotes in the opportunity context
roles.salesPointFollowUp: Manage calls, meetings, and next tasks

trust.title: Scale the team without giving up control of customer data
trust.accessDescription: Manage access by responsibility instead of distributing data freely.
trust.scopeDescription: Limit data according to the operating structure and assigned scope.
trust.auditDescription: Support traceability across system flows that provide activity logs.
trust.integrationDescription: Connect data through configured imports, webhooks, or integrations.

commercial.title: The solution is scoped to real scale and process complexity
commercial.description: The business discusses its needs before selecting scope; this page does not publish unapproved pricing.
commercial.scaleDescription: The number of users, teams, regions, and branches joining the system.
commercial.processDescription: The pipelines, stages, handoff rules, and approval flows that need standardization.
commercial.integrationDescription: The initial data sources, internal systems, and synchronization mechanisms required.
commercial.governanceDescription: The access scope, logs, training, and support appropriate to the organization.

demo.agendaDiscovery: Review current data, roles, and handoff points
demo.agendaWorkflow: Walk through leads, opportunities, quotes, and contracts

features.heroKicker: The customer lifecycle on one platform
features.heroTitle: From first lead to contract and post-sale service
features.heroDescription: VUM CRM connects the steps your teams perform every day so data stays intact across marketing, sales, operations, and service.

lead.title: Capture and qualify leads
lead.description: Record source, owner, contact status, and conversion criteria.

account.title: Build Account and Contact 360° profiles
account.description: Centralize company details, contacts, relationships, addresses, channels, and activity history.

opportunity.title: Manage opportunities through the pipeline
opportunity.description: Track stage, value, probability, expected date, and next action.

commerce.title: Connect opportunities with quotes, orders, and contracts
commerce.description: Preserve commercial context from proposal through delivery commitment.

automation.title: Standardize reminders and workflows
automation.description: Combine activities, notifications, and pipeline configuration so the team works consistently.

forecast.title: Track forecasts and performance
forecast.description: Aggregate opportunity data so leaders and managers can assess revenue progress.

governance.title: Control permissions, scope, and access history
governance.description: Apply roles, data scope, privacy controls, and audit logs within the same platform.

features.ctaTitle: See VUM CRM work with your business process

solutions.heroTitle: CRM should fit how your organization works and makes decisions
solutions.heroDescription: Instead of applying one template to every industry, VUM starts with your organization structure, sales cycle, and data-governance requirements.

regional.title: Regional teams with multiple management levels
regional.description: Assign customers, track performance, and limit data by organization, region, and team.

b2b.title: Long B2B sales cycles with multiple stakeholders
b2b.description: Preserve context from contacts, opportunities, and quotes through orders and contracts.

governed.title: Operations that require integration and traceability
governed.description: Connect data through imports, webhooks, and integration records while maintaining audit logs and privacy controls.
